policy.pricing_boundary_rule: If optimum is a boundary, extend to0.05H or4H before evaluation. NoBid is always feasible.
policy.uncertainty: All demand, retention, quality at scale, prices, provider terms and resource envelopes are explicit scenarios, not calibrated observations. Equal weights are reporting conventions, not estimated probabilities.
policy.source_qualification_scope: Only source-bound executed subset participates; all25 are screened. Scaled simulated jobs are not individually produced or independently accepted artifacts.
policy.optimality_scope: Best tested finite-price policy against a bounded responding rival and public population prior. No private buyer reservation values enter seller selection; no Nash or global optimum claim.

result.capital_metric_scope: No capital is actually withdrawn; possible replacement requires available earnings at least equal original seed, and does not gate commercial loop success.
